description: This file defines a helper object 'LaneHelper' with functions to manipulate lane and card data structures in a state object, likely used in a React/Redux application for managing a Trello-like board.

methods.name: initialiseLanes
methods.description: Initializes lanes with default currentPage and assigns laneId to each card.

methods.name: paginateLane
methods.description: Updates the current page of a specific lane and appends new cards.

methods.name: appendCardsToLane
methods.description: Adds new cards to a lane at a specified index or at the end.

methods.name: appendCardToLane
methods.description: Adds a single card to a lane.

methods.name: addLane
methods.description: Creates a new lane and adds it to the state.

methods.name: updateLane
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing lane.

methods.name: removeCardFromLane
methods.description: Removes a card from a specified lane.

methods.name: moveCardAcrossLanes
methods.description: Moves a card from one lane to another.

methods.name: updateCardsForLane
methods.description: Replaces all cards in a lane.

methods.name: updateCardForLane
methods.description: Updates a specific card within a lane.

methods.name: updateLanes
methods.description: Replaces the entire lanes array in the state.

methods.name: removeLane
methods.description: Deletes a lane from the state.
